paite: Ka aw in Pathian ka sam a; ka aw in Pathian ngei tuh ka sam ding a, ama'n kei lam ah bil ahon doh ding hi.
heading: Asaph phatna La / Lungzin Hun A Khamuanna
english: For the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm by Asaph. My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me.

paite: Ka buai ni in TOUPA ka zong a, zan chiang in leng ka khut khaikhe lou in ka zak gige a; ka hinna in khamuan a om anial hi.
english: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn’t get tired. My soul refused to be comforted.

paite: Pathian ka theigige a, ka buai naknak; ka ngaihtuah a, ka kha abah naknak. Selah
english: I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed. Selah.

paite: Ka mitvunte na haksak a, pau thei lou khop in ka buai hi.
english: You hold my eyelids open. I am so troubled that I can’t speak.

paite: Nidanglaite ka ngaihtuah a, tang lai hun leh kumte.
english: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.

paite: Zan a ka lasak ka thei nawn a; ka lungtang ah ka kingaihtuah a, ka kha in phatuamngaitak in azong hi.
english: I remember my song in the night. I consider in my own heart; my spirit diligently inquires:

paite: Toupa'n tangtawn in akhahkhe dia eita aw? Chik mah chiang in akipakta kei dia eita aw?
english: “Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?

paite: Azahngaihna amang tawntung dia eita aw? Athuchiam suan tengteng pha in amang dia eita aw?
english: Has his loving kindness vanished forever? Does his promise fail for generations?

paite: Pathian in hehpih a mangngilh a eita aw? Heh in lainatnate akhakta a eita aw? Selah
english: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he, in anger, withheld his compassion?” Selah.

paite: Huai ka hatlouhna ziak ahi; himahleh Tungnungpen khut taklam kumte ka theigige hi.
english: Then I thought, “I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High.”

paite: TOUPA thilhih thute ka gen ding a; nidanglai a na thillamdang hihte ka theigige ding hi.
english: I will remember Yah’s deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old.

paite: Nna nasep tengteng ka ngaihtuah ding a, na thilhihte leng ka sut ding hi, ka chi a.
english: I will also meditate on all your work, and consider your doings.

paite: Pathian aw, na lampi mun siangthou ah a-om a, Pathian bang Pathian thupi kua a-om a?
english: Your way, God, is in the sanctuary. What god is great like God?

paite: Nang thillamdang hihpa Pathian na hi a; michih lakte ah na hatdan na theisak zel hi.
english: You are the God who does wonders. You have made your strength known among the peoples.

paite: Na ban in na mite na honkhia, Jakob leh Joseph tate. Selah
english: You have redeemed your people with your arm, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

paite: Tuite'n ahon mu ua, Pathian aw, tuite'n nang ahon mu ua, akikou ua; tui thukpite leng aling uhi.
english: The waters saw you, God. The waters saw you, and they writhed. The depths also convulsed.

paite: Meipite'n tui asungbua ua; vante'n aw asuah ua; na thalte leng aphe zolzol hi.
english: The clouds poured out water. The skies resounded with thunder. Your arrows also flashed around.

paite: Na van-ging husa pingpei ah a-om a; khophiate'n khovel atanvak zolzol a; lei kising in aling dopdop hi.
english: The voice of your thunder was in the whirlwind. The lightnings lit up the world. The earth trembled and shook.

paite: Tuipi ah na lampi a-om a, na lampite tui zatak ah a-om a, na khapte theih ahi kei hi.
english: Your way was through the sea, your paths through the great waters. Your footsteps were not known.

paite: Mosi leh Aaron khut in na mite belamhon bang in na pipi hi.
english: You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
